802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.why: Heavyweight headliner pits No. 6 ranked Waldo Cortes Acosta, coming off two straight losses, against Johnny Walker, who scored a highlight knockout at UFC 332 last month in his heavyweight debut. Co-main sees former title challengers Tatiana Suarez and Virna Jandiroba clash, with the winner expected to earn a shot at strawweight champion Mackenzie Dern.
802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.know: Fight Night cards like this lack a title fight but often showcase contenders who can shoot up the rankings with one big win. Rankings run from champion down to No. 15 in each division, so a ranked fighter beating a tougher ranked opponent moves closer to title contention.

89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.why: San Francisco enters at 6-1 and sits atop the NFC West, while Las Vegas is a shakier 3-4. A win keeps the Niners' early lead solid and padded for the stretch run; a loss would be a stumble but not a crisis this early. No single November game clinches or ends anything yet, so watch for continued consistency and how banged-up the receiver group holds up.
89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.know: NFC West is San Francisco's four-team division; finishing first typically grants an easier path to the playoffs. Watch QB Brock Purdy, who leads a high-scoring offense, and Raiders pass rusher Maxx Crosby, their top defender who can disrupt the game.
